title: IOLANI PALACE

texts.text: This is a floor plan of the Iolani Palace in Honolulu, Hawaii, created for the Historic American Buildings Survey. The drawing details the layout of various rooms including the Hall of Representatives, Office of Public Works, and Treasury, along with verandas and stairways.

OFFICE - DEPARTMENT
OF PUBLIC WORKS
( OLD DINING ROOM )
OFFICE - DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS (OLD DINING ROOM)

NOTE: THIS SHEET WAS REDRAWN IN 1964 BY JOHN D MILNER FROM AN INK ON LINEN PLAN OF 1903 BY MARSTON CAMPBELL, ENGINEER, "ASST. SUPT. PUBLIC WORKS". EVEN TODAY, THIS IS THE ONLY KNOWN MEASURED DRAWING OF THE BUILDING. IT OMITS MANY ITEMS SUCH AS THE COLUMNS ON THE VERANDAS, BUT IS VALUABLE TO SHOW THE USE OF THE STRUCTURE IN THE EARLY TERRITORIAL PERIOD. — CHARLES E. PETERSON.
UNDER DIRECTION OF STATE DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR NATIONAL PARK SERVICE, BRANCH OF PLANS AND DESIGN
